name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.221.0 — Build capture gate joins prototype.url onto the relative route addresses the freeze writes in contract.json — a real frozen contract no longer dies on an invalid address at --mark captured; a relative address with no prototype.url declared is refused by name. 7.220.0 — Prototype lane fixes from the walkthrough host: --mark opened no longer checks the overlay import (the import lives on the prototype branch that opened creates), so a host without it on main no longer wedges as a stale branch — --mark round-done refuses until some file imports the overlay, records it as status.wiring, and the generated spec's File Plan drops that file when its diff is the import alone. An absolute brief path resolves instead of being joined under the root, and the Data/API sub-plan is written before harden/<stem> exists, so a failed write leaves no branch to wedge the rerun. proto-capture refuses when the page settles on a different path than requested (a signed-out login redirect was recorded as the route's baseline) and names a production build when fibers carry no _debugOwner. The overlay's queue bar and panel respect the safe-area inset, sit above host chrome, and flip to the top edge on tap. 7.219.0 — design-contract-check reads the Composite cell grammar instead of the raw cell: one or more PascalCase names, backticked or bare, prose around backticked names ignored (`Button kind="ink"` → Button, `Frame`'s → Frame). Each name must resolve in the kit, with one composite-missing finding per missing name; a cell naming no composite reports composite-missing with the cell text. genesis-driver's design-brief check compares the same parsed names through the shared compositeNames(). Previously every backticked cell reported missing.
